assertions.assertion: Response warns that the issuer URI (iss claim) must remain the same after migration
assertions.rationale: It states the golden rule that the issuer must stay exactly the same before and after migration and ties it to the iss claim.

assertions.assertion: Response explains that changing the issuer breaks existing tokens and/or client trust relationships
assertions.rationale: It explains a changed issuer makes previously issued tokens fail validation and breaks OIDC client trust relationships.

assertions.assertion: Response recommends setting options.IssuerUri explicitly in the Duende IdentityServer configuration
assertions.rationale: It shows pinning options.IssuerUri explicitly inside AddIdentityServer rather than leaving it inferred.

assertions.assertion: Response suggests checking the current /.well-known/openid-configuration discovery document to find the existing issuer value
assertions.rationale: Step 1 instructs hitting the old server's /.well-known/openid-configuration and copying the issuer value verbatim.
